python3 - <<'PY'
# free functions: record the marker when re-resolving
p='src/types/checker/functions/resolution/signature.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = """            widened[index].1 = exit_ty.clone();
            any = true;"""
new = """            widened[index].1 = exit_ty.clone();
            widened_indexes.push(index);
            any = true;"""
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
old2 = """        let mut widened = param_types.to_vec();
        let mut any = false;"""
new2 = """        let mut widened = param_types.to_vec();
        let mut widened_indexes = Vec::new();
        let mut any = false;"""
assert s.count(old2)==1
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
old3 = """        any.then_some(widened)
    }"""
new3 = """        any.then(|| (widened, widened_indexes))
    }"""
assert s.count(old3)==1
s=s.replace(old3,new3)
old4 = """        if let Some(widened) =
            self.by_ref_array_params_widened_by_body(decl, &param_types, &local_env)
        {"""
new4 = """        if let Some((widened, widened_indexes)) =
            self.by_ref_array_params_widened_by_body(decl, &param_types, &local_env)
        {"""
assert s.count(old4)==1
s=s.replace(old4,new4)
old5 = """            if self.resolving_by_ref_widening.insert(function_key.clone()) {
                let resolved = self.resolve_function_signature(name, decl, widened);"""
new5 = """            if self.resolving_by_ref_widening.insert(function_key.clone()) {
                for index in widened_indexes {
                    self.by_ref_widened_params
                        .insert((function_key.clone(), index));
                }
                let resolved = self.resolve_function_signature(name, decl, widened);"""
assert s.count(old5)==1
s=s.replace(old5,new5)
s=s.replace("    ) -> Option<Vec<(String, PhpType)>> {",
            "    ) -> Option<(Vec<(String, PhpType)>, Vec<usize>)> {")
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('free-function marker wired')
